simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שַׁמְגַּר (Shamgar) means Shamgar , an Israelite judge First listed occurrence: Judg 3 31.

definitions.full: H8044. Shamgar שַׁמְגַּר proper name, masculine a 'judge,' son of Anath , Judg 3:31 ; 5:6 , Σαμα[ε]γαρ (on this name (Hittite?) compare GFM 3:31 ; Nö ZMG xiii (1888), 479 conjecture שׁמגד ).
